title: Билеты, Расписания и Предсказания (Сортировка)
description: Распредели предложения по 4 группам: Future Simple, Future Continuous, Future Perfect и Present Continuous (для будущего).

items.verb: I think it will rain tomorrow.
At 5 PM I will be flying to Rome.
By 5 PM I will have finished my work.
We are meeting at 8 PM. We have tickets.
This time next week I will be lying on the beach.
I will help you with your homework.
By next year I will have graduated.
We are flying to London tomorrow.
